The Witcher 3 Remastered 5.00b D3DMetal proxy is from the upstream project:
https://github.com/tholtman1-del/witcher3-crossover-fix

Upstream commit: dc6c8f60c48ed08b61400e5b0a7327b5fdba63b1
Upstream license: MIT (see LICENSE.txt)
Proxy SHA-256: 46862167d7471bd41deee3edb11665b3dcecc86f20fe4ddcd666764cefe1827a

The DLL is an x86-64 Windows proxy for amd_fidelityfx_loader_dx12.dll. It
forwards FidelityFX calls to the game's original loader and applies the
upstream D3D12 pipeline and DPI workarounds. The source is included in
ffxproxy.source.txt. Boreal verifies the pinned hash before installing it.
